## What changed

Describe the change and why it is useful.

## Validation

- [ ] Firmware compiles, if changed.
- [ ] STL validation passes, if geometry changed.
- [ ] No credentials or generated build files are included.
- [ ] Documentation and photographs are updated where appropriate.

## Physical testing

State what was physically printed or assembled. A mesh check is not proof of fit,
weather resistance, electrical safety, or reliable unattended operation.
